theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Euclid P)) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ : NNReal), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → M ⊆ U → CountablyRectifiable n M → (∀ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C → C ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M ∩ C) ≠ ∞) → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → (∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ φ x)) → LipschitzWith Λ φ → AntilipschitzWith Λ φ → φ ⁻¹' U = U → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (approxTangentPlane n M x) ∧ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (φ '' M) (φ x) (Submodule.map (fderiv ℝ φ x : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) (approxTangentPlane n M x))
